skills.note: Acronym and its expansion name the same technology category.
Administration vs system administration is a wording difference only. Plain 'Linux' (usage/familiarity) is deliberately not merged.
Same language. 'Python scripting' is deliberately kept separate because it describes a narrower scope of use.
Spelling variants of the TCP/IP protocol suite. Deliberately NOT merged with 'computer networking', which is a broader field.
Broad networking competency. Kept separate from TCP/IP networking so a narrow protocol skill is not credited as the whole field, or the reverse.
Equivalent phrasing in job postings. Broader 'application security' and 'network security' are deliberately not merged.
Security qualifier is implied in this context. ITSM 'incident management' is a different discipline and is not merged.
Wording variants only. 'Malware analysis' and 'memory forensics' are specialisations and are not merged.
Acronym and company name for the same platform. Individual services such as 'AWS IAM' are not merged into this general skill.
General IAM discipline. Bare 'IAM' can also mean the AWS service, so 'AWS IAM' is deliberately kept separate.
Delivery expansion only. 'Continuous deployment' and standalone 'continuous integration' are narrower or different practices and are not merged.
Common abbreviation. Unrelated to Java, which stays separate.
Acronym and expansion. NoSQL is a different family of databases and is not merged.
Standard abbreviation. Docker is a different tool and stays separate.
Wording variants. 'Vulnerability assessment' and 'ethical hacking' are not merged.
Wording and plural variants. Generic 'API' and 'GraphQL' are not merged.

keep_separate.reason: Protocol suite vs the broader networking field.
General discipline vs a specific cloud service.
Using an OS, administering it, and administering a different OS are different competencies.
Relational query language vs a different database family.
General programming vs a narrower use.
CI/CD is the combined pipeline practice; the other terms name narrower practices.
Active exploitation vs identification of weaknesses.
Malware analysis is a specialisation, not a synonym.
Orchestrator vs container runtime and tooling.
A specific vendor platform is not the same as other platforms or the general field.
